_about: Test 1: first three clips of the S01E01 archery scene. Windows are measured from the dialogue track (tools/speech_windows.py), in seconds from the start of each clip. 'tts' is the text sent to TTS (Jankó respelled so English TTS says YAHN-ko); 'en' is the subtitle form. The pipeline makes every variant, then keeps the one that fits the Hungarian timing best.
